row.says: With the Dominators retreated back to wherever they came from, it looks as if Tunaria will recover from this famine.
row.note: Forkwatch (live-era footage, Oqb34SsGgck 38.5-64 s), work board 883

row.says:
Well, I'm sure you know about some of this, but I'll start from the beginning.
One day, Josephine Huely ran into the Qeynos city gates talking about a swarm of dreadful bugs.
While not everyone believed her, we soon found out she was telling the truth.
row.note: Forkwatch (live-era footage, Oqb34SsGgck 38.5-64 s), work board 883

row.says:
The chiktar and slith tar, which we found out were being controlled by a powerful force, came from their hives and invaded.
The slith tar infected just about every well on the continent and put a lot of taverns out of business temporarily.
Some thought that we were doomed to starve!
row.note: Forkwatch (live-era footage, Oqb34SsGgck 38.5-64 s), work board 883

row.says:
It was found that several evil eye dominators were controlling the queens of these races, therefore enslaving them all.
With their retreat, along with the dissolution of the chiktar and slith tar armies, everything seems to be back to normal.
row.choices: [{"text":"Are we safe from the famine now?","next":5}]
row.note: Forkwatch (live-era footage, Oqb34SsGgck 38.5-64 s), work board 883

row.says:
Things are looking up, and the grocers have been able to return to selling all their wares again.
However, this could be part of a larger plan...perhaps the retreat was a little hasty to be called a victory...
No, no, I'm fairly sure that we've beaten them. Cheers to you if you helped Tunaria beat these horrible foes!
row.note: Forkwatch (live-era footage, Oqb34SsGgck 38.5-64 s), work board 883

decline.after:
No, I already carry more than I should physically be able to.
I'm not running down there again.
